notes.title: New Content Released
notes.content:
[h1]New content released:[/h1]

- 2 new teachers.
- 8 new weapon upgrades.
- 8 new pet upgrades.
- 8 new desk item upgrades.
- New points system: upgrades now increase stars earned from bashing.
- 38 new Steam achievements.

notes.title: Windowed mode patch
notes.content: Windowed mode now rescales to 4:3 aspect ratio so that game is playable on any monitor setup.
